about: Teaching Story modelled on Devin Jatho's live 8-frame sequence (docs/stories/reference/devinjatho). Words come only from the source video's camera script.

source.title: How to Build a Sales Team AI Can't Replace

frames.title: Your AI and your setter [[don't talk]]
frames.bottom: And your leads are {{paying for it}} 👉

frames.title: Sales used to be **people only**
frames.body: One person knew the **whole story** of every lead

frames.title: Now **AI, setters and closers** all touch the same lead
frames.body: Without shared context, each one starts **from zero**
frames.pull: So how do you fix it? 👉

frames.title:
A lead asks:
**"Does this fit my work schedule?"**

The AI replies. The setter calls.
The closer gets the booking.
If none of them can see what the others said, the lead hears [[3 different stories]]
The **Human-AI Handoff**
items: A rule for when a person takes over

frames.title: This video shows you how to set it up 👇
frames.videoTitle: How to Build a Sales Team AI Can't Replace
